trechos.texto: I see a road that had more stones on it than it should have had, and even so, your determination is remarkable.
Everything you have won came from your own effort.
I noticed that few people held out a hand to you along that road.
There are days when you wake up well, and days when getting up is already the whole job.
Some days are lighter, others weigh more than they should.
And that weight does not seem to be yours alone.
There were important changes in your life in a recent period.
As for love: this person you feel what you feel for did not bring you the happiness you deserved.
On the contrary, they caused you pain.
And even at a distance, they still take up room in your thoughts.
